description:
Hi,

I have Opportunity with one of my client, please find below Job Description for your review. If you are interested please forward me your updated resume along with your contact details to discuss further. 

 Role: .Net Developer with NCR POS
Location: Bellevue, WA
Duration: Full Time / Permanent 

 Basic
 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
• At least 7 years of IT experience & strong in C#

 Preferred 
• At least 4 years of experience in .NET technologies including
• Working experience in NCR POS product is a must.
• Working knowledge of .NET 4.0 and above
• Experience in other POS products such as Fujitsu GlobalSTORE, Wincor, Epicor will be an added plus.
• Expertise in HTML5, Angular JS desirable
• Expertise in WCF, WebAPI, ASP .NET MVC
• Understanding of SOAP and REST
• Working knowledge in any Unit Testing Framework
• Expertise in any RDBMS , preferably SQL Server
• Familiarity with CI tools such as Jenkins, JIRA, GIT.
• Knowledge in Chef and Powershell
• At least 4 years of experience in software development life cycle.


 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
